meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把静态设计变成动感短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做短视频或社媒素材，想让画面更有动感
copy.tagline_en: Turn static designs into eye-catching motion shorts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you make short videos or social media content and want more dynamic visuals.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会把短需求做成通常 10 秒内、最长约 30 秒、无旁白的动效短片,例如文字动画、图表动画、Logo 展示等。它按「规划、取材、构建、自检、渲染」推进,渲染前征求你意见,输出 MP4 或透明背景视频到项目文件夹。
howto.when: 用户要求做短小动效视频(通常 10 秒内),如文字动画、图表动画、地图/界面动画等时,该技能接手;更长、带解说或多场景的会转给 /general-video,拿不准走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 帮我做一个 6 秒的文字动效,标题是『春季新品发布』。
say.note: 它会规划镜头,构建后渲染成 MP4。

say.text: 把这份销售数据做成柱状图动画,数字带滚动效果。
say.note: 会先判断是否需要取材,再构建图表并自检。

say.text: 做一个地图动画,高亮这几个城市并用线条连起来。
say.note: 会规划好镜头,最终渲染出 MP4 或透明背景。

howto.what_en: Claude makes short motion graphics (usually <10s, up to ~30s), no narration: kinetic type, chart animations, logo reveals, etc. It plans, sources, builds, verifies, asks before rendering, then outputs MP4 or transparent overlay to the project folder.
howto.when_en: Triggers on short motion-graphic requests (usually <10s): animated text, charts, map/UI animation, etc. Longer, narrated or multi-scene work goes to /general-video; unclear to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make a 6-second kinetic typography piece with the title 'Spring Launch'.
say_en.note: It plans the shot, builds it and renders an MP4.

say_en.text: Turn this sales data into an animated bar chart with count-up numbers.
say_en.note: Checks asset needs, then builds and verifies the chart.

say_en.text: Make a map animation highlighting these cities with connecting lines.
say_en.note: Plans the shot, then renders MP4 or transparent overlay.
